items.text: A side pane opened off a pane minimized in a collapsed row leaves the strips minimized.
A background window flashes its taskbar button when a pane starts waiting on the user.
The minimized-strip drag-out test aims at the strip it means to drag.
A pane opening out of the fold strip no longer holds up the glide's frame.
The fold-glide region-cut stall is traced to the UI thread blocking inside the window manager, and its fix is filed.
A divider drag on the composition path cuts each pane's rounded region once, at the drag's end, instead of every frame.
A divider drag on the default drawing path can keep each pane's rounded corners on the pane's own visual instead of re-cutting its window region every frame, behind GHOZTTY_DRAG_CARD_CLIP=1.
